generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Department Registration Details
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details
EMD Payments through KPPP-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditioned tenders will not be accepted.
The GST, Royalty, Income Tax & Other concerned Taxes will be deducted in works bills as per rules.

To qualify for Award of this Contract, each Tenderer in his /her name should have in the last Five Years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 and satisfactorily completed as a Prime Contractor at 1 similar nature of work value not less 50% of the amount put to tender (Scanned copy of the Work done Certificate issued by the Competent Authority of Rank not less that the Executive Engineer should be uploaded.
The Employer reserves the all rights to accept/ Reject any or/all Tenders and to cancel the tender process at any stage prior to award of the contract without assigning any reason.

Availability by owning at least 50% of the required / specified key and critical equipment for this work and The remaining 50% can be deployed on lease / hire basis for all works provided, the relevant documents (commitment agreements etc.,) for availability for this work are furnished.

Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than (Credit lines/ Letters of Credit/ Certificates from Banks) for meeting the fund requirement etc., (usually 30% of the amount put to tender)
The department is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPP portal.
All terms and Conditions as per tender documents.
1%of bill amount of the successful tenderer will be deducted as Building and other construction worker welfare cess.
The tenderer should maintain the work during the defective liability period of one year.
All materials required for the work, shall be procured by the tenderer himself and should be got tested by the quality control from the approved authorities at his own cost before use on work.
Agencies who have not completed previous work within the Stipulated time, since THREE Years in any one of the Divisions of K.S.D.B. will liable to be rejected.

To qualify for Award of this Contract, the Financial Turnover for each Tenderer in his /her name should have in the last Five Years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24. 2024-25 & 2025-26 achieved at least in two Financial years an average Financial Turnover not less 2 times of amount put to tender.

Statement indicating the total value of the Civil Engineering works executed and received in last Five years Certified by the Chartered Accountant to be Scanned & uploaded for civil works & Statement indicating the total value of the Civil Engineering works executed and received in last Five years Certified by the Chartered Accountant to be Scanned & uploaded for civil works.
Tenders from contractors who have not completed the works in time in any department, and/or Having litigation history or financial failures etc. will not be considered.
The Execute Engineer, No.2 Division, KSDB Bangalore has rights to accept or reject any of tenders without giving any reasons.

The details and other information will be made available in Executive Engineer, KSDB, No.2, Division KSDB, Bangalore office which can be collected during office hours. And also can see in the tender document.

If the contractor/Agency intendant to quote less than the Tender Amount contractor shall put a DD for the Tender difference amount quoted drawn in favor of Executive Engineer, No. 2 Division, K.S.D.B. Bangalore. The Tender Difference Amount of D.D should be produced at the Office of the Executive Engineer, No. 2 Division, and KSDB Bangalore office before 5:00 pm on 03/12/2026.
If the calendar of events is postponed, inform through the KPP-portal only.
GST amount will be paid Separately at the time of billing.

The Tenderer should visit the proposed site with concern Assistant Executive Engineer and submit the feasibility report regarding completion of works & upload the Site visit letter. The site visit letter failing to comply with these norms will make the tender liable to rejection.
The tenderer should be an Eligible Registered Civil KPWD License issued by the competent Authority.
All terms and conditions as per standard Tender documents KW-1

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Repair works to Samudhaya Bhavana (G Plus 1) constructed in L R Nagar Slum at Shtanthinagara Constituency, Bengaluru City.

itemList.description: Providing and placing on terrace (at all floor levels) polyethylene water storage tank, IS : 12701 marked, with cover and suitable locking arrangement and making necessary holes for inlet, outlet and overflow pipes but without fittings and the base support for tank.  (PWD Common SR - 2023-24 - Volume II - Item No.13.34, Page No. 123)

Painting with synthetic enamel paint of approved brand and manufacture of required colour to give an even shade :Two coats on new work over an under coat of suitable shade with ordinary paint of approved brand and manufacture after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.. (PWD Common SR - 2023-24 - Volume II - Item No.8.41, Page No. 48)

Providing and fixing M.S. grills of required pattern in frames of windows  etc. with M.S. flats, square or round bars etc. including priming coat with  approved steel primer all complete.  Fixed to steel windows by welding.  (PWD Common SR - 2023-24 - Volume II - Item No.13.34A, Page No. 86)

Sanitary Works: Providing and fixing Sewer (SWR) pipes, including all fittings, This includes jointing of pipes & fittings with one step solvent cement, trenching, refilling & testing of joints complete as per direction of Engineer in Charge.. (PWD Common SR - 2023-24 - Volume II - Item No.13.64.2, Page No. 128)  - 110mm nominal dia pipes

Providing 20 mm cement plaster of mix :1:6 (1 cement: 6 fine sand) to brick/stone masonary including rounding off corners wherever required smooth rendering, providing and removing scaffolding, including cost of materials, labour, curing complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge. (PWD SR 2025-26,Volume-II Item No. -  8.3.2, Page No.41)

Extra for providing and mixing water proofing material in cement plaster work in proportion recommended by the manufacturers including cost of material etc as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineerin- Charge. (PWD SR 2025-26,Volume-II Item No. -  8.12, Page No.43)

Providing and Applying PU based Elastomeric Liquid Applied PU Waterproofing Membrane single component, cold applied, water based acrylic PU dispersion with highly elastic and UV resistant water proofing treatment to the Existing Roof surface/Chajjas/Sunken portion of WC:Bathroom applied @ 1.2L/per m2,having tensile strength greater than 1.5N/mm2, elongation greater than 300% with solid content not less than 60% in 2 coats including surface preparation, priming the surface with water based acrylic primer @0.1 L/m2, and spreading 60 gsm geotextile between two top coats completely as per specification. The finished cost to include surface preparation, making coving at Junction, Bore Packing, treatment of construction joints completely as per specification & with a 10 years warranty on product & work from certified manufacturers as per the direction of the Engineer In charge. (PWD SR 2025-26,Volume-II Item No. -  15.2, Page No.149)

Finishing walls with Acrylic Smooth exterior paint of required shade :New work (Two coat applied @ 1.67 ltr/10 m² over and including priming coat of exterior primer applied @ 2.20 kg/10 m²) with paint of approved quality to give an even shade, after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of aterials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge. (PWD Common SR - 2023-2024 - Volume II - Item No.8.30, Page No. 46)
